# Infographic: Products Liability


Download Kinsale’s[Products Liability Infographic](https://www.kinsaleins.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/ProductsLiability_Infographic.pdf) to discover coverage we offer!


Kinsale’s Products Liability Division provides Commercial General Liability, Products Liability, and standalone Product Recall Expense and Liability coverages


on an occurrence or claims-made coverage basis. Our underwriting focus is on **importers, distributors** , and **manufacturers of consumer, commercial,** and **industrial products** . Kinsale can tailor coverage to your hard-to-place and distressed risks.


**Target Classes include:**


**Manufacturers:** Emphasis on most consumer, commercial and industrial products, including:


- [Cannabis](https://www.kinsaleins.com/industries/cannabis/) dispensaries, distributors, growers and processors; includes plant oil processing and extraction equipment
- Consumer appliances and electronics
- Firearms and ammunition, including handguns, rifles, military, law enforcement, replicas, and imports
- Body armor and ballistic clothing
- Machine shops and machinery manufacturing
- Motorcycles, scooters, and e-bikes
- Recreational and sporting goods
- Tobacco and e-cigarette manufacturers and importers
- Toys, games, and clothing


*(Note: Claims-made retroactive date continuity provided)*


Questions?[Contact our team of Products Liability underwriters.](https://www.kinsaleins.com/meet-your-underwriters/?division=products)
